scene: a woman at a café window table holding a coffee cup, medium close-up, eye level, late afternoon sun

findings.A: bright, evenly sharp, generic stock-photo look
findings.B: warm natural skin, darker softer background, believable window light; the strongest lift for people
findings.C: clean, neutral, the setting readable behind; commercial and product look
findings.D: wider, nearly everything in focus, slightly tilted; reads as a real phone photo
findings.E: horizontal blue flare and oval bokeh; cinematic, the flare needs a strong light source
findings.F: grain, soft contrast, swirling bokeh; a stylized vintage look

decision: film-cooke, digital-zeiss, phone and anamorphic are the recommended kits by format; vintage-16 and every part stay available on request
